housing: Baltimore's rentals are mostly brick rowhouses, rented whole or split into apartments, plus apartments in converted mills, warehouses and older mid-rises.

localRules.text: Baltimore City requires every non-owner-occupied rental, including single-family houses, to be registered and licensed, with a passing inspection by a state-licensed home inspector.
Landlords without a Baltimore rental license can lose the right to collect rent and must give their license number when filing a failure-to-pay-rent case.

climate: Rowhouses often have older radiators and window units, so test the heat and cooling, check basements for water after rain, and photograph any lead paint chips or peeling paint on older trim.
fact: Baltimore was the seventh US city to give tenants a right to a lawyer in eviction cases.
